datasets.name: High-Resolution Digital Elevation Model (HRDEM) product
datasets.source: Quebec Ministry of Natural Resources and Forests
datasets.verbatim: I would like to acknowledge that the dataset used in this study comes from the High-Resolution Digital Elevation Model (HRDEM) product based on LiDAR data by Quebec Ministry of Natural Resources and Forests.

datasets.name: Landslide inventory of Retrogressive and Rotational landslides

methods.name: Attention ResU-Net
methods.summary: A deep learning semantic segmentation model based on the U-Net architecture, utilizing a ResNet-50 encoder and attention gates in the skip connections to focus on relevant features for landslide detection from HRDEM derivatives.
methods.verbatim: To develop and implement the Attention ResU-Net model specifically for our study, we employed the GeoPatch Python package (Shahabi, 2022) to preprocess the dataset.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not mentioned or linked, and the custom code for the Attention ResU-Net model lacks a repository or persistent link.
